verdict.rationale: Folk's pricing page lists 'Pipeline management' as a feature. Its docs say custom objects such as Deals, Projects or Partnerships are defined per group, which suggests separate pipelines can exist for different motions. Nothing documents configurable stage sets or multiple distinct pipelines, so the capability is only glancingly evidenced. missing for 10: documentation of multiple pipelines, per-pipeline stage configuration, stage set differences across products/motions, hands-on or independent corroboration

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run multiple pipelines with different stage sets for different products or motions

citations.quote: A custom object is a record of an object type defined inside a group: Deals, Projects, Job Applications, Partnerships, or anything else your workflow needs.
